research_status: Exploratory continuation of claude/cool-bohr-oco47t; no profitable trading alpha certified
usefulness_definition: User accepts independently measured forecast improvement; trading value is a separate test

candidates.source: Copernicus Sentinel-2 short-wave infrared via Element 84's public AWS archive
candidates.observable: Fraction of clear acquisitions with furnace heat in a fixed smelter area
candidates.forecast: Quarterly copper smelter throughput and refined copper production
candidates.possible_alpha: Production surprises at concentrated listed producers, or aggregate copper supply
candidates.timing: Use only images created before the forecast cutoff; compare with the later company production release
limitations: Hot slag and neighboring units can be mistaken for furnaces
Clouds hide heat
Refinery output can differ from smelter throughput
Public outage schedules may already explain the signal

candidates.observable: Season-matched new exterior built area at publicly identified data-center campuses
candidates.forecast: Delivery and revenue-recognition delays relative to building-specific schedules
candidates.possible_alpha: Guidance surprises at operators where one project is material
baseline: company disclosures and guided completion dates
candidates.timing: Gate on public site identity and every composite input's publication time; never backdate an alarm to the start of a retrospectively identified pause
limitations: Interior work is invisible
Completed roofs look stalled
Historical areas of interest were chosen with hindsight
Legacy CSVs lack full constituent scene lineage

candidates.source: NASA MODIS vegetation imagery through USDA NASS VegScape
candidates.observable: Growing-season county NDVI and its change across crop stages
candidates.forecast: State corn, soybean and wheat yield anomalies before final annual outcomes
candidates.possible_alpha: Crop supply surprises versus expectations in grain futures and exposed businesses
candidates.timing: Weekly imagery is usable only after the composite ends plus an explicit publication lag; train on earlier crop years
limitations: One county is a proxy for a state
Current-vintage weather and yield labels are not an original-vintage archive
Forecast skill is not the same as predicting market surprises

candidates.source: Satellite-constrained CERES surface irradiance via NASA POWER
candidates.observable: Monthly all-sky surface shortwave radiation at a solar plant
candidates.forecast: Solar electricity output before independent EIA reporting
candidates.possible_alpha: Weather-driven output and revenue surprises for solar assets
candidates.timing: Downloaded historical SYN1DEG has 3-4 month latency and cannot certify month-end nowcasts; original FLASHFlux vintages required
limitations: Current-vintage estimation test only
One plant and six evaluation years
Contemporaneous market expectations not measured

candidates.source: NOAA CPC OISST Niño3.4, combining satellite and in-situ temperatures
candidates.possible_alpha: Seasonal rainfall risk relevant to agriculture, hydroelectric output and energy supply
candidates.timing: October 15 forecast after September data and assumed 14-day OISST final-product latency; original CPC vintages unavailable
limitations: An established public ENSO mechanism, not proprietary information
Current-vintage reprocessing
Satellite-specific contribution not isolated from in-situ inputs
Uncertainty gate fails

candidates.source: NOAA/NSIDC Sea Ice Index passive-microwave satellite observations
candidates.forecast: September mean Arctic sea-ice extent, forecast August 15
candidates.possible_alpha: Seasonal conditions relevant to Arctic shipping and energy logistics; route-specific access and economic exposure remain untested
baseline: expanding linear trend plus previous September extent
candidates.timing: Current-vintage archive with explicit August 14 assumed availability; audit original August press releases and disclose revisions
limitations: Physical forecast target uses the same product family at a future date, not independent shipping output
Current revised archive; original-vintage operational performance uncertified
Exploratory sixth candidate; no cross-candidate multiple-testing adjustment
No financial returns or contemporaneous market expectations evaluated for this signal

candidates.source: UAH MSU/AMSU lower-troposphere satellite temperatures, USA48 monthly series
candidates.forecast: Winter residential natural-gas demand before EIA monthly reporting
candidates.possible_alpha: Demand surprises in gas markets or utility revenue forecasts
candidates.timing: Issue next-month 15th after assumed feature availability; earlier EIA labels embargoed until two months after their month-end; current-vintage inputs
limitations: Adds no forecast value beyond ground heating-degree days in fixed test
Layer temperature is not surface temperature
Historical source revisions and EIA methodology change
Separate costed UNG test is negative
